topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I can't help but feel a certain lightness as I discovered someone had tattooed my artwork onto their skin. It's like they've carried a piece of my soul with them, a part of me walking alongside them, forever intertwined with their story. It's an honor, really, to see such a personal connection to something I created. The world is a vast canvas, and to have my creation become a part of it in such an intimate way – well, it's almost poetic. It's moments like these that remind me why I pour my heart into my art.
